title: Hologram
look: A sci-fi projection: cyan translucent light with scanline fill, HUD brackets, a projector base and the odd glitch.

doc.essence: The character as a projected hologram: made of cyan light you can see through, drawn in horizontal scan bands, hovering above a projector inside a targeting HUD, glitching now and then.
doc.notIt: Not neon (a scan-line fill you can see through, one cyan, a HUD and a projector), not glass (no colour blobs, no tint of the character's own colour), not x-ray (one hue, light not density).
doc.shapes: A soft wide cyan glow under a crisp thin edge on every part.
doc.colour: Only cyan: a faint translucent fill crossed by brighter scan lines.
doc.eyes: Near-white cyan, the brightest thing in the frame.
doc.motion: Smooth, with a two-frame horizontal glitch every few seconds.
pitfalls: The glitch is a short shift, never longer than two frames, so it reads as a fault, not a jump.
Translucent overlapping parts add up: the face sits on top so it stays readable.
